official_definition: Return this exhausted Spirit to the Hand, and you must summon a Cost Y "[Name]" with a different name from your Hand, without paying the cost. You can only use this effect of the same card name once per turn.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Form Change] or [Form Change: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Form Change]", "give [Form Change]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
